decisions.reason: As a newly launched but strategically distant recruitment service outside the firm's maritime-focused integrated offering, Product A has weaker fit and likely lower option value relative to the managerial attention it absorbs, so management would be inclined to redeploy resources unless traction becomes clear very quickly.

Because it builds directly on the firm's established crewing capabilities, customer base and maritime network, Product B is a low-cost adjacent option whose uncertainty is still worth carrying for another year.
